result.brief: 提出区域非均匀前向动力学（吸收+均匀混合核），让离散扩散模型在训练中接触"可信但不确定"的上下文，并配合推理期噪声重注入采样器，提升受污染条件下的填充鲁棒性。
result.reason: Discrete diffusion forward-process design with region-dependent corruption kernels; abstract frames it as a trust axis analogous to diffusion inpainting signal-to-noise, a concrete transfer to continuous latent/flow design.
